proposals.name: ARROW LAKES
proposals.lead: Arrow Lakes = Upper Arrow Lake wbk:328961689 + Lower Arrow Lake wbk:328961720 (BCGNIS 43779 'Arrow Lakes', recorded, -117.8095 50.1832; both registry items carry variant 'Arrow Reservoir'). Row is a cross-reference with no rules of its own — binding it adds nothing.

proposals.name: ARROW LAKES' TRIBUTARIES
proposals.raw_regs: See Lower Arrow Lake's tributaries and Upper Arrow Lake's tributaries
proposals.lead: Tributaries of wbk:328961689 and wbk:328961720; both have their own tributary rows. Pointer only.

proposals.name: SEVEN MILE RESERVOIR
proposals.lead: The impoundment behind Seven Mile Dam on the Pend d'Oreille River; the book's PEND D'OREILLE RIVER row (MU 4-8) says it 'Includes the reservoirs behind Waneta Dam and Seven Mile Dam'. No FWA lake polygon or BCGNIS name exists for it (river polygon). Pointer only — rules already ride the river.

proposals.name: SEVEN MILE RESERVOIR'S TRIBUTARIES
proposals.lead: = Pend d'Oreille River's tributaries row. Pointer only.

proposals.name: WANETA RESERVOIR'S TRIBUTARIES
proposals.lead: = Pend d'Oreille River's tributaries row. Pointer only. (Registry 'Waneta Reservoir' wbk:329262640 is just a 19 ha manmade polygon at the border.)
